title: Output Period Values
description: Denominator and counting grains registered in the output-aggregator registry. Canonical source is libs-server/data-views/output-aggregator-registry.mjs; period names are the legacy rate_type tokens with the per_ prefix stripped.

periods_by_aggregation.note: season is a count-only period; there is no (season, rate) tuple. A (period, aggregation) pair absent from these lists throws 'No output aggregator for (period=..., aggregation=...)' at dispatch.

time_grain.mechanism: Divides by, or counts, distinct periods keyed on (year, week, esbid) for game and (year, seas_type) for season
time_grain.use_case: Season-long averages, consistency metrics, threshold-game counts

team_unit.description: Team-level denominators from the per-team-play plugin family
team_unit.mechanism: Divides by team-level play, drive, series, or clock-segment counts

player_opportunity.description: Player-specific opportunity denominators from the per-player plugin
player_opportunity.mechanism: Divides by the player's own countable opportunities

player_participation.description: Playing-time denominators from the per-player-play and per-player-route plugins
player_participation.mechanism: Divides by snaps or routes run

play_level_classification.description: Whether the denominator varies with the column's play-level filter params. Canonical source is NON_PLAY_LEVEL_PERIODS in libs-shared/data-views-output-tokens.mjs.
play_level_classification.consequence: Non-play-level periods ignore output_column_params / output_match_column_params; the column-param UI disables denominator-param overrides for them.

silently_dropped.reason: per-game normalization is meaningless when each row is already one week
silently_dropped.behavior: normalize_output_param removes the output param and logs at debug level

rejected.reason: a season-grain count cannot be attributed to a single week row

year.note: All periods are compatible with a year row axis.

legacy_token_mapping.description: Legacy rate_type tokens map onto (period, aggregation: 'rate') by stripping the per_ prefix. Full table in libs-shared/data-views-output-tokens.mjs.
